guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows a massive spike in recommendationservice_socket (+371%, z=+74) alongside extreme latency increases in recommendationservice and productcatalogservice, while frontend logs explicitly report failures to get product recommendations. This indicates recommendationservice is exhausting socket connections or hitting connection limits, causing cascading delays and errors.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the socket/connection pool limits or fix connection leaks in recommendationservice to prevent exhaustion and restore downstream availability.
